scope: Chromium CDP multi-touch and native keyboard/mouse browser review. Not Unity or physical-device certification.

checks.name: Two touches on one upgrade: release stops all repeats and preserves the release-time wallet
Secondary finger release never commits a tap or stops the original hold, on same/different cards
A shop hold owns the gesture: another card/batch button does not add a purchase on release
Keyboard batch/resonance clicks are ignored during a pointer hold and work again after release
Touch cancel clears the hold; a new touch buys exactly one level without reviving old timers
Blur/navigation before the threshold leaves no delayed purchases after two-finger input
